title: Goldman Sachs 10,000 Small Businesses
description: Goldman Sachs' 10,000 Small Businesses program helps small businesses create jobs and economic opportunity by providing greater access to business education, financial capital, and business support services.  For more information visit http://link.gs.com/H6K8

asr.full_text: Our guiding principle in this country is equality of opportunity and 10,000 small. Businesses is a big part of it. I love making coffee. I love talking about coffee. I love coffee a lot. What I love about my business is that it fixes lives. Any sort of artwork that you see on clothing when you're in a store, we've probably made it. We are an energy solutions company. We are a mechanical contracting firm based out of Philadelphia. Healthy Food Company, we're based in Harlem. New Orleans. Detroit. Miami. When I started my company, we had one employee. The second day we had one employee and a coffee pot. Almost every big business was a small business. We had no business background when we started. The hard part is keeping the business afloat. There has been a lot of challenge involved. With the family and also the company. That wants to grow at the same time. The Goldman Sachs 10,000 Small Businesses program. It gets you in the mindset to stop working in the business and work on the business. To be put in a room with 23 other people. Hi everyone, I'm Amy Belosio. It made so much sense in that every day that I left there, there was something on my list. That I could immediately apply to my business. The time I took the program we had 13 employees. Now after the program we have over 100. Our income was $400,000. We are over three and a half million. When we expand from two to five locations,. We were about double the amount of employees. My company is going to skyrocket. To be able to create jobs and have a positive impact on our community. We're. Doing a service that our society really needs. The work that you do is just all. Around you. Sancerio Most is graduating from high school. Give them a hand. When I meet a small business person,. I never feel better about the prospects of the United States. And the strength of our people. And that the American trajectory in the world. Is secure for another generation. Thank you.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it presents a Goldman Sachs small-business support program focused on education, capital access, and business services. Business owners discuss their companies and program-based management support, while reported income and employee increases are framed as participant experiences rather than guaranteed returns. The “GROW REVENUE” wording fits the business-development theme, and no required payment, credential request, deceptive condition, or investment-return solicitation is described.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central subject is a small-business program described as providing business education and support, with a participant describing business-focused learning she could apply to her company.

evidence.observation: The description presents the program as providing business education, financial capital access, and business support services.
evidence.quote: program helps small businesses create jobs and economic opportunity by providing greater access to business education, financial capital, and business support services.
